New in Sentinel 1.20.1 Argus

Steadier live marks, clearer warnings, and a companion that keeps your choices.

Every change in this version

Live scanning

  • Marks stay on their rows when a theme change or a new tab only looks like a scroll.
  • Opening a new tab clears the last page's marks at once.
  • Marks that go now fade out gently.
  • In Serious only, the scan effect no longer tints safe links.
  • The hover tip no longer covers other marks.

Warnings

  • Warnings put their main reason in the heading.
  • Warnings follow Simple view: fewer words, a bigger answer.
  • Warning cards no longer sit on a pale square.

The app

  • On Settings, the / key jumps to the settings search.
  • A long wait offers Try again after 8 seconds.
  • Pages hold their shape while they load, at any width or text size, so nothing jumps.
  • Switching Animation from Off back to Full brings back the page's scroll motion without a reload.
  • Under Full animation, choices slide from one option to the next.
  • Screen readers now hear the Animation choice's name.

Colour and brand

  • Gold text on light pages is easier to read and still gold.
  • In light mode, each colour choice looks clearly different from the others.
  • The colour preview shows real gold for Gold, whatever colour you picked.
  • The phone preview shows the green safe example again.
  • The installer shows the Sentinel name under the mark.
  • A sharper tab icon on high-resolution screens.

Browser companion

  • If browser sync fails, your settings are kept on this computer instead, and the newest choice always wins.
  • The companion popup follows your text size and spacing.
